from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document that determine its cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document as provided")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case, e.g. '民事', '刑事', '行政'")
    procedural_stage: str | None = Field(description="The procedural focus, e.g. '执行', '审理', '登记', '再审'")
    dispute_subject: str | None = Field(description="The core subject matter of the dispute, e.g. '借贷', '执行', '继承', '征收', '登记', '财产侵占'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseRecord]
